resources.string: Turn SIM lines on or off and open the mobile data SIM screen.
Taps the SIM line switch on the SIM manager screen once, only when you tap a SimTap widget cell. It reads only the SIM manager screen and remembers SIM names and on/off states to show on the widget.

Turn SIM lines on or off and jump to the mobile data SIM screen from a 4x1 home screen widget. SimTap opens the SIM manager screen and its accessibility service taps the switch for you.

On Android 13 and later, apps installed from outside an app store are blocked from accessibility until you allow them. Open App info, tap ⋮ at the top right, tap Allow restricted settings and verify. Then turn on SimTap in Accessibility.
This home screen cannot add widgets directly. Long-press an empty area of the home screen and pick SimTap in Widgets.
Opens the SIM manager screen without tapping anything so the widget can show SIM names and states. Go back when it opens.
